notes.title: DEMO V.1 IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[p][b][i]⭐Our demo is now live![/i][/b]⭐[/p][p]This is our team's first ever release to Steam, so it has been a journey to even get the demo out, we hope that you enjoy the small time spent in Silver Tree!
Any bugs or issues found, we are in the process of setting up a Discord for all reports to be posted in. In the meantime, we will be keeping a close eye on the Steam community page.

Love,
Violet Mischief [/p]
